name: Suki AI
short_description: AI-powered voice assistant and ambient medical scribe with deep EHR integrations, voice commands for hands-free chart navigation, and support for 100+ medical specialties.
long_description: Suki AI is an AI-powered voice assistant and ambient clinical intelligence platform for healthcare professionals, founded in 2017 by former Google product manager Punit Soni. Unlike pure-ambient scribes, Suki combines ambient documentation with voice commands for ordering, charting, navigation, and clinical Q&A. The platform captures patient-clinician conversations to generate structured clinical notes, provides ICD-10 and HCC coding assistance, and offers multilingual support for 80+ languages. With bi-directional, real-time integration with Epic, Cerner, athenahealth, and MEDITECH Expanse, Suki enables hands-free EHR navigation. The platform serves 400+ healthcare organizations across 100+ medical specialties and has raised $168M in funding from investors including Venrock, Philips Ventures, and Flare Capital.
one_liner: AI voice assistant and ambient scribe with EHR commands for 100+ specialties
best_for: Multi-specialty physician practices and health systems seeking ambient documentation combined with voice-activated EHR commands and hands-free chart navigation
not_for: Mental health-specific practices (consider Mentalyc or Upheal)

faqs.a: Suki AI is an AI-powered voice assistant and ambient medical scribe that captures patient conversations to generate clinical notes, while also providing voice commands for EHR navigation, ordering, and clinical Q&A.

faqs.q: How much does Suki AI cost?
faqs.a: Suki Compose starts at $299/month per user for documentation, while Suki Assistant with full EHR integration starts at $399/month per user. Enterprise pricing requires a custom quote.

faqs.q: Which EHRs does Suki integrate with?
faqs.a: Suki has bi-directional, real-time integration with Epic, Oracle Health (Cerner), athenahealth, and MEDITECH Expanse.

faqs.q: How many specialties does Suki support?
faqs.a: Suki supports 100+ medical specialties with specialty-aware documentation models, including primary care, cardiology, orthopedics, dermatology, psychiatry, and many others.
